# Claude Motion Video

> An AI text animation and motion graphics generator. Turn a sentence, a screenshot
> or a title into an animated video. Every frame is rendered as code by Claude Opus 5.5,
> so text and UI stay sharp and any line can be changed without re-rendering the clip.

Independent product. Not affiliated with Anthropic.

## Core pages
- Homepage / text animation generator: https://cmotionvideo.com/
- Animated text animation tool: https://cmotionvideo.com/text-animation-generator
- Animated title generator: https://cmotionvideo.com/animated-title-generator
- Examples (470+ real clips with prompts): https://cmotionvideo.com/examples
- Effects library: https://cmotionvideo.com/effects
- Pricing: https://cmotionvideo.com/pricing

## Specs
- Max clip length: 30 seconds
- Aspect ratios: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1
- Export: 1080p MP4
- No Claude subscription or API key required

## Effects available
Letter drop, masked rise, typewriter cursor, stretch slide-in, squash and stretch,
outline echo, decode scramble, skewed wipe.

## What it is not
- Not a pixel-painting video model (unlike Sora / Veo / Seedance): every frame is
  code, which is why text and UI stay sharp.
- Not affiliated with Anthropic.
